subject.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): share channel DM policy setup

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-dm-policy` become a supported long-term plugin API, or should this refactor remain internal to bundled channel implementations?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the SDK’s public surface; tests can show implementation behavior but cannot decide the compatibility and ownership commitment for external plugin authors.

options.title: Approve a stable SDK contract
options.body: Keep the entrypoint after documenting and testing the intended callback, account-resolution, and upgrade contract for external plugins.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Use a non-public shared implementation for bundled channels until there is a demonstrated external plugin need and owner-approved API shape.

recommendation.title: Approve a stable SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the entrypoint after documenting and testing the intended callback, account-resolution, and upgrade contract for external plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history shows steipete authored the proposed public SDK and channel migration surface.
